videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:

videos.author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
videos.description:
Antidepressants don't make people happy overnight. Instead, they slowly change how brain cells communicate, helping worn-down neural circuits recover over time. Here's why they take weeks to work, and why they help millions of people.
